evals.name: product-launch-decision-makers
evals.prompt: Fais-moi une vidéo rustmotion de 30 secondes en 16:9 pour annoncer le lancement de FerrisKey, un IAM open source en Rust. La cible ce sont surtout des CTO et des DSI. Fais-la relire par plusieurs profils pour l'améliorer.
evals.expected_output: A 1920x1080 video around 30 s refined over at least one debated round, with decision-maker as primary audience and the three built-in personas active.
assertions: Before the brief, the working-directory question offers exactly two options: create ./<slug>/ or use the current directory
The authoring guide is loaded from a local clone (crates/rustmotion/skills/SKILL.md) or raw GitHub before any scenario is written
The rustmotion binary is checked for the sheet subcommand before generation
brief.md names a primary audience
Gate 1: storyboard.md is shown and the turn ends before any scenario.json exists
Every round-N/scenario.json passes rustmotion validate (schema and geometry)
Every round directory contains sheet.png, rendered after validation
Pass-1 sub-agents are dispatched in a single message, one per active persona, and receive no other persona's review
Personas receive the brief, the storyboard and the sheet, never scenario.json
Every active persona has a pass1.md and a pass2.md matching the strict YAML formats
synthesis.md separates consensus from disagreements and decides disagreements by the primary audience
Gate 2 ends the turn after every synthesis
The reason the loop ended is stated (user stop, all pass-2 scores >= 8, or max rounds)
Gate 3 gives final.mp4, the score trajectory per persona and what remains unresolved
brief.md format is 1920x1080 and duration 30
The primary audience is decision-maker
